name: Pets
description: Lets Caelum players pick a pet that follows them in Caelum-only lobbies ($pet). The pets come from pets.txt and a server modpack.

choices.label: More pets
choices.description: Extra pets without editing pets.txt: name:model.bml:part:idle:walk:scale_percent:who entries separated by commas. pets.txt wins a name listed in both.

side.label: Distance to the side
side.description: How far beside the player the pet walks.

behind.label: Distance behind
behind.description: How far behind the player the pet walks.
